summary: Implemented and activated the Benefitsi-owned Stripe Connect test-mode booking core: private provider/offer/review/slot/booking/audit/webhook schema, human-gated offer publication, test-only Connect Express onboarding, destination-charge Checkout with immutable application-fee snapshots, transactional inventory holds, concurrent idempotency recheck, signed replay-safe webhooks, cancellation/refund state machine, Booking Control UI, and city-review safety remediation.

commands.command: scoped git diff --check in both repositories
targeted atomic Supabase migration application and remote migration list verification

verification: Remote migrations 20260728150000 and 20260728170000 are recorded and both schemas/RPCs exist.

Rolled-back E2E proved offer publication, same-booking idempotency replay, sold-out blocking, duplicate webhook ignore, confirmed-to-refunded state, five audit entries and two unique webhook receipts.
Authenticated browser showed live regional review data and the human publish button only for the clean Bachstelzkerwe case.
Authenticated Booking Control showed active schema with Stripe Test-Key missing and no live-payment capability.
Next.js was patched from 16.2.6 to 16.2.12; remaining npm audit findings are transitive PostCSS/Sharp advisories without a safe non-breaking npm remediation.
safety: Only sk_test_ secrets are accepted and live Stripe webhook events are rejected.
Provider KYC is hosted by Stripe; Benefitsi and agents do not store KYC fields.
Offer publication requires clean Ben review, enabled test provider and explicit human admin action.
Checkout price, currency, destination and application fee come only from the locked database hold.
Slot rows are locked before capacity calculation and idempotency is rechecked after the lock.
Signed webhook processing and its audit receipt occur in one database transaction.
Community event moderation no longer invents a two-hour end time.
Review pilot seeds cannot overwrite a later human decision.
known_limits: No Stripe test secret or webhook secret is configured locally, so no external Stripe account/session was created and no Stripe card test was attempted.
Merchant-of-record, taxes, cancellation terms, dispute liability and live payout ownership remain production blockers.
The historical Supabase migration directory remains incomplete for older remote versions, but the two new versions are now aligned local/remote.
Partner-isolated operations, guarded test refunds, exports and operational alerting belong to T006.
